name: SPCAM v3.0 aquaplanet simulation dataset (reference and +/-4K SST perturbations)
model_or_instrument: SPCAM v3.0 (CAM3 coupled to 2D cloud-resolving model SAM)
size_as_stated: approximately 45 million samples using every model time step and grid column for each set (training, validation, test)
resolution: 2.8° x 2.8° horizontal resolution, 30 vertical levels (up to 3.5 hPa), 30 min CAM timestep; embedded CRM with eight 4-km columns, 20 s timestep

scales.note: SPCAM v3.0 aquaplanet with 2.8° CAM grid (dx ~311 km) and 4 km embedded CRM; 30-min coupling/output interval across training, validation, test, and 1-year prognostic runs.
